list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18 (the two lists agree on every name, description and grade).
note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are this site's own words, written for this guide; sources are named beside each guide and never copied. Where no published method exists yet, the guide says so honestly instead of inventing one.

trophies.guide: The Platinum pops by itself once the other 54 trophies are yours — there is nothing extra to do for it. It is the last trophy you will earn, and it closes the whole list. PowerPyx rates the full set 4/10 in difficulty and about 200 hours, with a single playthrough enough and no online trophies at all.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 — the trophy pops when the mission ends. This is the first mission of the game, so it will be one of your earliest trophies.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every main mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing this guide flags as possibly missable: the first meditation, Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every main mission in Chapter 2. Playing as both characters together opens up after Chapter 2 (following the mission Coffee Break), which is also what unlocks the last meditation spot — see Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every main mission in Chapter 3. Keep scanning vehicles and studying animals with the binoculars as you travel between missions — that progress already counts toward the 100% checklist even before it unlocks.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every main mission in Chapter 4. Save manually at the start and end of each chapter: missions cannot be replayed, and a manual save is your only way back if you want to redo a chapter's choices.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the final mission and the gold pops with the credits. Once the story is over, the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, and free roam opens for the whole clean-up stage.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the main mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Main-mission trophies like this one pop automatically as you play through the chapters.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the main mission The Cartel Heist. Heist-style missions are part of the story path, so just keep following the main missions.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the main mission Child's Play. Like every named-mission trophy, it unlocks the moment that mission's end screen appears.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the main mission Headliners. No preparation is needed — story missions hand you the trophy on completion.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the main mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The airport is also the setting of the Catch Me If You Can trophy, so remember the layout — you will come back to it in free roam.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the later named missions, so it will pop naturally as you work through the story.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the gold that the whole clean-up stage is built around. The 100% checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, after the story — but progress you made during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx notes the checklist is lenient: it is roughly 60% of true completion. It needs, among other things, every robbery, every underwater discovery, all Shooting Range challenges, all drone races and the Bret quests, 70 of the 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied through the binoculars, and 15 of the 18 meditation spots. Work through this guide's Stage 3 and it falls last, just before the Platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts while driving — jumps, near misses, drifts and air time all count toward the stunt total the game tracks. This is a grind that builds up on its own if you drive boldly instead of carefully: take jumps, thread traffic and use ramps whenever you see them. It is also on the 100% checklist's orbit, so most players finish it during the post-story clean-up rather than farming it in one sitting.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's 9 activity types once — fishing, the shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, racing, hunting and the other open-world activities each count as one type. You do not need to win or finish any of them, just sample each one. Do it early: most types unlock in the first chapters, and sampling them as they appear is faster than hunting them down later.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The ranges are found around Leonida and each challenge scores you on accuracy and speed, so bring a steady hand and retry any challenge that lands silver — retries are unlimited. This is required for the 100% checklist too, so gold every range during the post-story clean-up and this silver pops with it.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations across Leonida. Each location hosts its own race, so work through the map one site at a time and learn each course's corners — a win at every site is what counts, not a single victory. Drone races are also on the 100% checklist, so they are part of the Stage 3 clean-up.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the key word is different, so each race event only counts once. Race events are scattered around Leonida; enter a new one each time rather than replaying a favourite. Pick fast cars for road races and learn the shortcuts on each course; 20 wins across 20 events is a steady afternoon of racing, not a grind.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activities you meet early — the opening mission is Gone Fishing — and Cal is the rival angler who challenges you. Take the challenge when it is offered, match the fishing minigame's prompts, and out-fish him to pop the trophy. If the challenge does not appear at once, keep fishing at the usual spots and it will come around.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — any cabinet, any game, just play it through to its end. Arcade cabinets sit in bars and amusement spots around Leonida; pick the shortest game you find and finish it. You only need one completion, so this is a quick bronze to grab whenever you pass a cabinet.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Andy's missions are Lucia-only, so play them as Lucia when they appear. Stranger strands stay available after the story — every quest giver tied to a trophy comes back in free roam — so you cannot lock yourself out of this one, but do Andy's missions as they appear to keep the strand moving.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand. Kenton's missions appear as stranger icons on the map; follow the strand through each mission until its finale. Like the other stranger finales, it can be finished after the story, so there is no rush — just keep answering Kenton's calls and icons when they show up.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. Billy's missions are biker-flavoured stranger missions; follow the strand from its first icon to its last. Stranger strands do not expire for trophy purposes, and Billy's finale is doable in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and two more strangers make up the set. A strand counts when you finish its final mission, so this silver pops once any 8 of the stranger finales are done. Work the stranger icons as they appear on the map and in free roam; the named finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) each carry their own bronze too.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger strand. Randy's missions are supply-run style stranger missions; follow the strand through to its finale. It counts toward the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks, and it is finishable after the story in free roam.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. Tyrone's missions are Jason-only, so play them as Jason when they appear. Like the other stranger finales it stays open after the story, so finish it in the Stage 3 clean-up if you have not already.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, in 10 locations, as both Jason and Lucia. This is the ONLY trophy reported as possibly missable, so read this one carefully. The first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate — follow her to the balcony and choose Accept, and she shows you how. That spot is reported gone after Chapter 1, and while it is unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy, the safe move is to do it before Chapter 1 ends. The last meditation needs both characters playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. For the 100% checklist only 15 of the 18 spots are needed, so this trophy is stricter than the checklist.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — Bret's strand is a hunting strand, and one of its hunts targets a single unique animal. Bret's missions are Jason-only, so take them as Jason. Track the animal with the hunting tools the strand teaches you, take the shot cleanly, and the trophy pops when the hunt is done. Bret's quests are also required for the 100% checklist, so this one is on the critical path.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, interiors, out in the world — and each set needs every card in it. Pick up cards whenever you spot them during the story and the clean-up; completing any 3 sets is enough, so focus on the sets you are closest to finishing. A few magazine-style collectibles sit in story buildings that later become inaccessible, but they also spawn elsewhere, so no card is missable.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo-sharing style check-in: open it at landmarks, viewpoints and notable spots around Leonida and post from each one. The counter is per location, so revisit new places rather than repeating one spot. Work it into your exploration for The Goodtime State — the two trophies share the same road trip.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges, which come in 8 groups of 10. Challenges reward all kinds of play — driving, combat, exploration, activities — so they fill up naturally as you chase the other trophies. Note that the 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80, so by the time you finish A Long Road you will have passed 50 already; do not farm challenges early, just let them accumulate.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely and escape. Get the heat up together — cause chaos with your partner in the car or on foot until the fourth star appears — then break line of sight, hide, and wait for the wanted level to drain to zero while your partner is still with you. Do it in open country where you can outrun the search, not in a dead-end street.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the trick is the opposite of Hot Together: here you must KEEP the heat. Rob the first shop, drive straight to the second and then the third, and do not let the wanted stars clear between robberies. Plan a route of three close shops in advance, keep a fast car ready outside each one, and do not stop to fight the police.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or scan new vehicle models as you meet them and the discovered count climbs. This is the casual cousin of the 100% checklist's vehicle scanning (200 of 277 base models): every new model you scan counts for both. Cruise varied districts, try car parks, dealerships and traffic, and the count will pass 100 long before you finish the checklist's 200.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-time aiming mode: trigger it when a group of enemies is bunched up, and line up five quick kills before the meter runs out. A gang shootout or a police ambush with enemies in the open is the right moment — do not waste it on one or two stragglers. If you fall short, just retry at the next big fight.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, steal a plane and take off without a flight plan. Get onto the VCIA tarmac in free roam, grab a small plane, and get airborne while the airport security reacts. The story mission VCIA Takedown teaches you the airport's layout, so use what you learned there and leave fast once you are on the runway.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhino tanks — the description's joke is the clue: get inside a Rhino and use it, or take one on, until the trophy pops. Rhinos appear at high wanted levels and around military areas; at 4 or 5 stars the army rolls them out. Our own advice from the description: drive a Rhino around and cause chaos with its cannon, which is the natural reading of the trophy. No published guide has pinned the exact trigger yet, so treat this as the best reading of the description rather than a confirmed method.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth robbery, not a smash-and-grab. Case the store first, go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails: leave, let the heat die down and try again. Patience beats speed here.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the big robberies of the open world: plan the approach, crack the vault, grab the cash and then lose the wanted level before the next. Each vault counts only if you escape clean, so do not rush from one bank to the next while the heat is still on. This is required for the 100% checklist too, so it is part of Stage 3.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — spot one, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level. A sticky approach works: block the road ahead of the truck, hit it hard, grab the money and vanish before the police box you in. One clean robbery and escape is all it takes.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — the whole state, from Vice City out to the swamps and the Keys. The game tracks each named area the first time you enter it, so a deliberate road trip after the story clears the stragglers: drive the coast road, cross the bridges, and sweep the rural corners the story never sent you to. Pair it with You WAiNKer! and check in at 100 locations on the same trip.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one hit per gang. Illegal operations are the gangs' off-the-books businesses marked around the map; hit one for each gang and the trophy pops. Learn which operation belongs to which gang before you strike, so you do not waste a hit on a gang you have already robbed. Expect armed resistance at every one.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — find a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a sea view and order a cocktail there. HONEST UNKNOWN: as of 20 November 2026 no published guide has pinned down the exact spot or the exact prompt for this one, so the description is the only clue and this guide will not invent a location. Try the beachfront bars on Ocean Drive and look for a drink-with-a-view interaction; this entry will be updated when a real method is published.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method not yet known)

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through a showroom's glass front and out onto the street, the old-school GTA way. HONEST UNKNOWN: as of 20 November 2026 no published guide has confirmed which showroom or the exact trigger, so do not take any single dealership name as fact. Try the larger vehicle showrooms in Vice City in free roam; this entry will be updated when a real method is published.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method not yet known)

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — follow through on a bowling game there, frame by frame, until the game ends. Bowling is one of the activities, so the alley is a real location in Vice City: walk in, start a game and finish it. It is a nod to the classic GTA IV bowling alley, and it counts as one of the activity types for Master of None too.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — the description points at doing something notable together with your partner that the public notices. HONEST UNKNOWN: as of 20 November 2026 no published guide has pinned down the exact act, so this guide will not invent one. It is likely tied to a partner activity or a public stunt with your partner; try the partner activities and watch for a prompt. This entry will be updated when a real method is published.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method not yet known)

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks progress toward 500 of them. The game is full of small decisions: dialogue choices, approach choices on missions, partner decisions, what to do in stranger encounters. There is no single trick; just play the game making choices whenever they are offered and the counter climbs. It pops late, near the end of a thorough playthrough, so do not chase it early.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — the description suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt after failing the first. HONEST UNKNOWN: as of 20 November 2026 no published guide has pinned down which activity or challenge this tracks, so the description is the only clue and this guide will not invent a method. A likely shape is failing a challenge or minigame once and then passing it on the retry. This entry will be updated when a real method is published.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method not yet known)

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — the description is the trophy's own punchline: witness something strange in Leonida. HONEST UNKNOWN: as of 20 November 2026 no published guide has confirmed the exact event or location, so this guide will not invent one. It is most likely a random world event or an easter-egg encounter — keep playing, explore odd corners of the map, and it should find you. This entry will be updated when a real method is published.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method not yet known)

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. HONEST UNKNOWN: as of 20 November 2026 no published guide has pinned down the exact setup, so treat the description literally: drive past a pedestrian, swing a melee weapon from the vehicle, and knock them over. It is a bowling pun on the drive-by, and the trophy name says it all. This entry will be updated when a real method is published.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method not yet known)

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — bank vaults, armored trucks, illegal operations — and your contacts wash them into clean cash for a cut. Keep robbing, keep laundering, and the total climbs: it is a long economy grind that runs alongside Maximum Withdrawal and Pest Control, so do not treat it as a separate job.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, car parts, food, anything sold in a shop counts toward the total. This one finishes itself if you play rich: buy the good guns, upgrade your cars, dress both characters well, and the counter passes $100,000 during the clean-up. It pairs naturally with Little Boxes, since garage properties are bought from the same money.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Garages go on sale as you explore and earn — check property listings as you travel, and buy each garage when it appears. You need serious cash for all 8, so this lands late, after the robbery trophies have filled your pockets. Garages also give you somewhere to keep the 10 vehicles for On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the in-game app that tracks your rides. Open the app, register a vehicle you own or have just found, and repeat until 10 are on the list. Your garages from Little Boxes are the natural source: buy a garage, fill it with varied vehicles, and register them from there.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game
